s: June 13, 2012 - Since juicing apples are considerably cheaper than number 1 apples, it makes sense to buy them for certain purposes. For example, if you plan to make can lot of applesauce or apple pie filling, you can save quite a bit just by using a lower quality apple. Juicing apples (number 2’s) can be bruised a little bit, they can be misshapen, small or have skin blemishes. You may even find a few that have been cut or gouged. I’ve ordered them for our family before; they can be kept about a week or up to two weeks if you’re careful to take out any bruised ones.
